answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock collateral in a cryptographic vault and permanently burn a non-refundable fraction upon identity registration. Collateral requirements scale with superlinear quadratic cost, O(N^2), forcing an attacker’s expense to explode exponentially relative to identity count. A malicious actor with ferrous hardware cannot mine cheap identities; like grazing across a fertile meadow, expanding nodes burns fatal capital.
